msg.hotkey_help.zh: 如果热键无响应，请点击开始录音，并确认终端或 VS Code 已开启输入监控权限。
msg.hotkey_help.en: If the hotkey does not respond, click Start Recording and ensure Input Monitoring is enabled for your terminal or VS Code.

bubble.greeting.zh: 嗨，我是 BB 👋 按 {hotkey} 开始说话
bubble.greeting.en: Hi, I'm BB 👋 press {hotkey} to talk

account.tip.zh: 通过浏览器登录，凭据安全保存并自动续期
account.tip.en: Browser sign-in with protected credentials and automatic refresh

account.browser.zh: 请在浏览器中完成 {provider} 登录…

account.not_signed_in.zh: 尚未登录 {provider}，请点击登录按钮。
account.not_signed_in.en: Not signed in to {provider}. Click the sign-in button.

account.recover.zh: 重新登录以修复 {provider} 凭据
account.recover.en: Sign in again to repair {provider} credentials

msg.copilot_profile_invalid.zh: Copilot 推理强度须为 low/medium/high，输出预算须为 16–16384 的整数。
msg.copilot_profile_invalid.en: Copilot reasoning must be low/medium/high; the output budget must be an integer from 16 to 16384.

account.device_code.zh: 请在 {url} 输入设备码：{code}。完成 GitHub 授权后会自动继续；请勿分享设备码。
account.device_code.en: Enter device code {code} at {url}. Sign-in continues after GitHub authorization. Do not share this code.

msg.signin_browser.zh: 请在弹出的浏览器中完成 Azure 登录…
msg.signin_browser.en: Complete the Azure sign-in in the browser window…

msg.not_signed_in.zh: 未登录 Azure：点击顶部橙色『登录 Azure』横幅即可开始。
msg.not_signed_in.en: Not signed in to Azure: click the “Sign in to Azure” banner at the top to start.

msg.pick_model_first.zh: 请先选择或输入一个本地模型名称。
msg.pick_model_first.en: Please select or type a local model name first.

msg.downloading_model.zh: 正在下载模型 {name}（首次较慢，请稍候）…
msg.downloading_model.en: Downloading model {name} (first time is slow, please wait)…

msg.model_no_local_engine.zh: 此安装包为 Azure 精简版，未内置本地 Whisper 引擎，无法下载模型。请改用完整版（含离线 Whisper）。
msg.model_no_local_engine.en: This build is the lean Azure edition without a bundled local Whisper engine, so models can't be downloaded. Please use the Full edition (with offline Whisper).

msg.local_engine_missing.zh: 此安装包为 Azure 精简版，未内置本地 Whisper 引擎。请在设置中使用 azure 或 codex 后端，或用 BB_INCLUDE_LOCAL=1 重新打包。
msg.local_engine_missing.en: This build is the lean Azure edition without a bundled local Whisper engine. Use the azure or codex backend in Settings, or repackage with BB_INCLUDE_LOCAL=1.

msg.first_setup.zh: 首次启动：请选择后端和模型。Full 版可在 MLX 模型中填写模型 repo id 或本地路径。
msg.first_setup.en: First launch: choose your backend and model. In the Full edition, MLX model accepts a repo id or local path.

msg.diagnostics_copied.zh: 诊断信息已复制到剪贴板，可粘贴给 Bubble Buddy skill 排查。
msg.diagnostics_copied.en: Diagnostics copied to clipboard — paste it into the Bubble Buddy skill.

msg.copied_history.zh: 已复制历史记录到剪贴板。
